decisions: RoutineRegistration carries RoutineTypeId only: RoutineParameterCatalog has no code->id lookup. Application must resolve the id; ForCode is not possible.
Odometer reading evaluates with LastTimeEvaluationDate without advancing it (D-04 and odometer-ingestion spec), not with the Bogota date of the reading as the task text says.
Domain events carry OccurredAt without a clock: reading.ReadAt for readings, Bogota start of the effective date for register and reevaluate.
PagedResult<T> did not exist in BuildingBlocks; created in Application/Abstractions (ns ...Application.Abstractions) with Items, Page, PageSize, TotalCount.
Commands without a natural value return the aggregate id (VehicleId/RoutineId/AlertId/RoutineTypeId); no Unit type exists. Plate in commands and DTOs is a plain string.
OdometerReadingLogEntry is an Application record (VehicleId, Kilometers, ReadAt, ReceivedAt, Outcome, IgnoredReason) per ADR-0025; Infrastructure should map it to its own persistence class.
RoutineSnapshot.EffectiveDueSoonPercent (int in V1) is mapped from the decimal snapshot value with Math.Round AwayFromZero.
MaintenanceRoutineRestartedV1.ServicedAt is built from ServiceRecord.Date at 00:00 UTC (DateTimeOffset), since the domain keeps a DateOnly.
The mappers are public sealed classes with a parameterless constructor; the DI registration (scan or manual) is up to whoever owns the DependencyInjection file.

decisions: AddOutboxRelay requires the host to register IClock and the TContext DbContext; the batch processor is scoped and resolved per cycle by OutboxRelayService.
Transport is registered with TryAddSingleton so several AddOutboxRelay<TContext> calls in one host share a single EventBusPublisher.
A failure while deserializing a payload is treated as a delivery failure (RegisterFailure) and stops the batch, preserving order.

HandleFamily<TMarker,...> requires TMarker : IIntegrationEvent (needed for IIntegrationEventHandler<TMarker>); IRoutineSnapshotEvent/IServiceOrderSnapshotEvent do not extend it, so they must to be usa…
Registry key is the EventName; the dispatcher extracts it from envelope.Type (rutaviva.{svc}.{Name}.v1 -> Name, or the raw type if not in that format).
Host/dispatcher are internal; the service must register its own scoped IEventCheckpointStore and IUnitOfWork for Checkpoint (Latest gets in-memory and null defaults via TryAdd).
